messages:
tariq (Security): Auditor wants a tight artifact that ties the RBAC rolebinding change to the KMS decrypt that was part of the incident. Need: role_binding_id, who made the change, change diff, kms_decrypt_request_id, decrypt response status, deploy_id, and an analyst statement. Can we assemble and sanitize by EOD?
claire (Infra): yes. we'll pull k8s audit log (rolebindings.v1.rbac.authorization.k8s.io), cloudtrail/cloud audit logs for iam.SetIamPolicy/SetRoleBinding, and KMS decrypt logs. Do you want the raw events or a joined CSV?
auditor_lee: joined CSV is preferable with ISO8601 timestamps. Include the exact queries and time window, plus sha256 of the bundle. Also include a short mapping doc to SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO 27001 controls (A.9, A.12). Redact customer PII.
sam (Oncall): note: KMS decrypt failed once (status=ACCESS_DENIED) then succeeded after role fix. include both events and the retry window. Also include CI pipeline id for the fix deploy: pipeline/4821.
tariq (Security): include a signed analyst note that summarizes timeline (who changed binding -> who approved -> k8s rollout -> KMS decrypts). I'll sign with our internal GPG key.
claire (Infra): running exports now. Queries I'm using: 
```bash
# k8s audit: rolebinding change
jq '.items[] | {ts:.metadata.creationTimestamp, user:.metadata.annotations.kubernetes\.io/created-by, object:.objectRef.name, verb:.verb, uid:.metadata.uid}' /var/log/k8s_audit.jsonl > rbac_changes.ndjson

# cloud audit (GCP) for iam policy change
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND resource.type="k8s_cluster"' --limit 1000 --format json > iam_changes.json

# KMS decrypts (CloudWatch/Stackdriver)
# Filter for Decrypt API calls and include request/response IDs
```
claire (Infra): export started: export-id=exp-20260401-9c3a; estimated 42MB; destination=s3://redwood-audit/exp-20260401-9c3a.tar.gz
export-bot: started export exp-20260401-9c3a by claire at 2026-04-01T18:12:02Z
claire (Infra): uploaded bundle and manifest at s3://redwood-audit/exp-20260401-9c3a/; manifest sha256=8f2c1d6b9c4a5e7f2b3a1c4d5e6f7a89123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0; mapping csv includes join keys: service_account, role_binding_uid, requestID, pipeline_run_id
auditor_lee: please include the query text and the exact time window used for each query, and who executed them. Also need to confirm PII redaction method.
sam (Oncall): scrub run: `python infra/tools/pseudonymize.py --in exp-20260401-9c3a.ndjson --fields customer_email,customer_id --mode pseudonymize --keep service_account,requestID`
claire (Infra): scrubbed copy uploaded to s3://redwood-audit/exp-20260401-9c3a/scrubbed/ ;presigned link created (14 days): https://s3-presigned.example/exp-20260401-9c3a.tar.gz?sig=YYY
auditor_lee: good. one more ask: include evidence of KMS key policy change (if any) and key rotation metadata near the incident time. Also include last-used timestamp for the service account.
tariq (Security): added key rotation and last-used fields to the mapping.csv; prepared an analyst narrative.txt describing sequence and control implications. I will sign the narrative and add chain-of-custody notes: who pulled, scrubbed, uploaded, and the checksum.
auditor_lee: for SOC2 evidence please map each exported field to control language. e.g., rolebinding.audit -> CC6.3 access provisioning; KMS decrypt log -> CC7.2 cryptographic key usage. A one-page mapping is fine.
claire (Infra): manifest updated with mapping.pdf and analyst-signed.txt. export-bot: export completed at 2026-04-01T18:34:20Z; export-id=exp-20260401-9c3a; size=42.3MB; checksum=sha256:8f2c1d6b9c4a5e7f2b3a1c4d5e6f7a89123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0
auditor_lee: Received. I'll do an initial review; if we need raw traces we'll request a narrow sample. Thanks for the clear chain-of-custody. :thumbsup:
tariq (Security): filing evidence into the SOC2 artifact tracker and creating retention ticket to hold the bundle for 90 days (audit agreed sampling window). tagging @legal for redaction approval.
sam (Oncall): quick FYI: KMS key rotation log shows last rotation 2026-01-15; no unexpected rotations around incident. also included kube service-account lastUsed=2026-03-29T11:02:04Z in metadata.
claire (Infra): closing this thread. if auditor needs a signed, time-stamped affidavit, ask and we'll produce.
